description: Submission of details pursuant to Conditions 2.4 and Condition 1.30 of Planning Permission F/04687/13 dated 23 July 2014 for the Brent Cross Cricklewood Regeneration Area to provide updated versions of the Zonal Floorspace Schedule and the Floorspace Thresholds for Building Zones Schedule to reflect a change of 100,000sqm (total) of Class B1 development floorspace to Class C3 development floorspace within the Station Quarter (51,493sqm) and Market Quarter (48,307sqm) Development Zones.  This application also includes a submission pursuant to Condition 1.30 to make associated amendments to defined terms within the Glossary to Conditions within Section 73 Planning Permission F/04687/13 to reflect the proposed changes.
application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
site_name: Station Quarter And Market Quarter Development ZonesBrent Cross Cricklewood Regeneration AreaNorth West LondonNW2
